source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed condensed interim financial statements 3Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (9 months to 30 September 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-3, reviewed interim statements from p.4 (auditor PwC). Thousand Baht. SCI three months p.7, nine months p.9. Revenue and expenses 24.1 (p.82, printed sideways; columns non-PAA / PAA / total, nine months, both years): incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA. This edition adds a row 'impairment of the insurance acquisition cash flow asset' ((40,851), PAA), which has no line item; it is added to acquisition amortisation so that the expense total closes (owner decision 2026-11-11). CSM roll-forward 19.1.2 p.72 (ยอดสุทธิ ณ วันที่ 30 กันยายน พ.ศ. 2568); future-service change = change in estimates + onerous line (7) + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business 19.1.3 p.74: no total column; the onerous column is nil, so the non-onerous column is the total. The opening CSM is 74,348,041 (as in 2Q2025; 1Q2025 printed 74,722,569). Other revenue = อื่นๆ (24.1). RA release uses 24.1 (463,143), not the AOC RA (462,769). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 September 2568 (p.7).
